<script>
document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const titleBlock =
            document.querySelector(
                "#title-block-header .quarto-title"
            );

        const codeButton =
            document.querySelector(
                "#quarto-code-tools-menu"
            );

        if (
            !titleBlock ||
            !codeButton
        ) {
            return;
        }


        /*
         * Find the original dropdown menu.
         */

        let dropdownMenu = null;

        const originalParent =
            codeButton.parentElement;

        if (originalParent) {

            dropdownMenu =
                originalParent.querySelector(
                    ".dropdown-menu"
                );

        }


        /*
         * Fallback search in case Quarto changes
         * the exact DOM structure.
         */

        if (!dropdownMenu) {

            dropdownMenu =
                document.querySelector(
                    "#quarto-code-tools-menu + .dropdown-menu"
                );

        }


        if (!dropdownMenu) {

            dropdownMenu =
                document.querySelector(
                    ".quarto-title .dropdown-menu"
                );

        }


        /*
         * Create centered wrapper.
         */

        let container =
            document.querySelector(
                ".centered-code-tools"
            );

        if (!container) {

            container =
                document.createElement(
                    "div"
                );

            container.className =
                "centered-code-tools";

            titleBlock.appendChild(
                container
            );

        }


        /*
         * Move the Code button and menu together.
         */

        container.appendChild(
            codeButton
        );

        if (dropdownMenu) {

            container.appendChild(
                dropdownMenu
            );

        }


        /*
         * Disable Bootstrap's original dropdown
         * toggle because this menu is controlled
         * by the custom script below.
         */

        codeButton.removeAttribute(
            "data-bs-toggle"
        );

        codeButton.setAttribute(
            "aria-expanded",
            "false"
        );


        /*
         * Open or close the Code menu.
         */

        codeButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function (event) {

                event.preventDefault();

                event.stopPropagation();

                if (!dropdownMenu) {
                    return;
                }

                const isOpen =
                    dropdownMenu.classList.contains(
                        "code-menu-open"
                    );

                dropdownMenu.classList.toggle(
                    "code-menu-open",
                    !isOpen
                );

                codeButton.setAttribute(
                    "aria-expanded",
                    String(
                        !isOpen
                    )
                );

            }
        );


        /*
         * Do not close the menu when clicking
         * an item inside it.
         */

        if (dropdownMenu) {

            dropdownMenu.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function (event) {

                    event.stopPropagation();

                }
            );

        }


        /*
         * Click anywhere else to close the menu.
         */

        document.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                if (!dropdownMenu) {
                    return;
                }

                dropdownMenu.classList.remove(
                    "code-menu-open"
                );

                codeButton.setAttribute(
                    "aria-expanded",
                    "false"
                );

            }
        );


        /*
         * Escape key also closes the menu.
         */

        document.addEventListener(
            "keydown",
            function (event) {

                if (
                    event.key !== "Escape" ||
                    !dropdownMenu
                ) {
                    return;
                }

                dropdownMenu.classList.remove(
                    "code-menu-open"
                );

                codeButton.setAttribute(
                    "aria-expanded",
                    "false"
                );

            }
        );

    }
);
</script>


This project develops an applied decision-support system for Capital Bikeshare using dynamic simulation, linear optimization, and interactive geospatial visualization.

The central question is:

> Given station capacities, bike inventories, observed trip flows, and limited rebalancing resources, how should bikes be redistributed to improve service while controlling relocation cost?


::: {.panel-tabset}

# Overview & Data


## Part 1 — Project Scope and Decision Problem

The project combines real Capital Bikeshare data with numerical simulation, linear optimization, and interactive geographic visualization.

The pilot analysis uses January 2025 trip records.

## Part 2 — Data Sources and Temporal Scope

The project uses:

- January 2025 Capital Bikeshare trip history;
- current GBFS station information and station status;
- DC GIS station metadata;
- DC ZIP-code polygons.

The historical trip records and current GBFS snapshot describe different time periods. Current inventory is used for present-system visualization and network validation, not as January 2025 historical inventory.

### 4.5 Trip Time and Duration Audit

```{python}
trip_times = trips_raw[
    [
        "started_at",
        "ended_at",
    ]
].copy()

trip_times[
    "started_at"
] = pd.to_datetime(
    trip_times[
        "started_at"
    ],
    errors="coerce",
)

trip_times[
    "ended_at"
] = pd.to_datetime(
    trip_times[
        "ended_at"
    ],
    errors="coerce",
)

trip_times[
    "duration_seconds"
] = (
    trip_times[
        "ended_at"
    ]
    - trip_times[
        "started_at"
    ]
).dt.total_seconds()
```

```{python}
pd.DataFrame(

                "started_at"

)
```

```{python}
trip_time_audit = pd.Series(
    {
        "Missing start times":
            trip_times[
                "started_at"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Missing end times":
            trip_times[
                "ended_at"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Nonpositive durations":
            (
                trip_times[
                    "duration_seconds"
                ]
                <= 0
            ).sum(),

        "Trips shorter than 60 seconds":
            (
                trip_times[
                    "duration_seconds"
                ]
                < 60
            ).sum(),

        "Trips longer than 24 hours":
            (
                trip_times[
                    "duration_seconds"
                ]
                > 24 * 60 * 60
            ).sum(),
    },
    name="Count",
)

trip_time_audit.to_frame()
```

Trip durations are audited but are not automatically removed.

## Part 5 — Build and Validate the Current Station Network

GBFS station information and station status are joined by `station_id`. DC GIS station metadata provide an independent station reference.

The resulting table represents the current network, not January 2025 inventory.

### 5.1 Merge the Current Station Sources

```{python}
station_info = (
    station_info_raw
    .copy()
)

station_status = (
    station_status_raw
    .copy()
)

station_info[
    "station_id"
] = (
    station_info[
        "station_id"
    ]
    .astype("string")
)

station_status[
    "station_id"
] = (
    station_status[
        "station_id"
    ]
    .astype("string")
)
```

```{python}
gis_station_reference = (
    stations_raw[
        [
            "STATION_ID",
            "REGION_NAME",
            "CAPACITY",
            "LATITUDE",
            "LONGITUDE",
        ]
    ]
    .copy()
)

gis_station_reference[
    "STATION_ID"
] = (
    gis_station_reference[
        "STATION_ID"
    ]
    .astype("string")
)

gis_station_reference = (
    gis_station_reference
    .rename(
        columns={
            "STATION_ID":
                "gis_station_id",
            "REGION_NAME":
                "gis_region_name",
            "CAPACITY":
                "gis_capacity",
            "LATITUDE":
                "gis_lat",
            "LONGITUDE":
                "gis_lon",
        }
    )
)
```

```{python}
station_snapshot = (
    station_info
    .merge(
        station_status,
        on="station_id",
        how="inner",
        validate="one_to_one",
        suffixes=(
            "_info",
            "_status",
        ),
    )
    .merge(
        gis_station_reference,
        left_on="station_id",
        right_on="gis_station_id",
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
)

station_snapshot.shape
```

### 5.2 Network Validation

```{python}
station_snapshot[
    "is_operational"
] = (
    station_snapshot[
        "is_installed"
    ].eq(1)
    &
    station_snapshot[
        "is_renting"
    ].eq(1)
    &
    station_snapshot[
        "is_returning"
    ].eq(1)
    &
    station_snapshot[
        "capacity"
    ].gt(0)
)
```

```{python}
network_validation = pd.Series(
    {
        "GBFS stations":
            len(
                station_snapshot
            ),

        "Unique station IDs":
            station_snapshot[
                "station_id"
            ].is_unique,

        "Missing station IDs":
            station_snapshot[
                "station_id"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Missing short names":
            station_snapshot[
                "short_name"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Missing latitude":
            station_snapshot[
                "lat"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Missing longitude":
            station_snapshot[
                "lon"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Missing capacity":
            station_snapshot[
                "capacity"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Matched to DC GIS":
            station_snapshot[
                "gis_station_id"
            ].notna().sum(),

        "Capacity differs from DC GIS":
            (
                station_snapshot[
                    "capacity"
                ]
                !=
                station_snapshot[
                    "gis_capacity"
                ]
            ).sum(),

        "Operational stations":
            station_snapshot[
                "is_operational"
            ].sum(),

        "Inactive stations":
            (
                ~station_snapshot[
                    "is_operational"
                ]
            ).sum(),
    },
    name="Value",
)

network_validation.to_frame()
```

### 5.3 Current Inventory State

```{python}
station_snapshot[
    [
        "station_id",
        "name",
        "short_name",
        "capacity",
        "num_bikes_available",
        "num_docks_available",
        "num_bikes_disabled",
        "num_docks_disabled",

```

```{python}
station_snapshot[
    "bike_fill_ratio"
] = np.where(
    station_snapshot[
        "capacity"
    ] > 0,
    (
        station_snapshot[
            "num_bikes_available"
        ]
        /
        station_snapshot[
            "capacity"
        ]
    ),
    np.nan,
)
```

```{python}
station_snapshot[
    "inventory_state"
] = (
    pd.cut(
        station_snapshot[
            "bike_fill_ratio"
        ],
        bins=[
            -np.inf,
            0.25,
            0.75,
            np.inf,
        ],
        labels=[
            "Low bikes",
            "Balanced",
            "High bikes",
        ],
    )
    .astype("string")
)

station_snapshot.loc[
    ~station_snapshot[
        "is_operational"
    ],
    "inventory_state",
] = "Inactive"
```

## Part 7 — Interactive Current Station Inventory Map

The map shows the current GBFS inventory snapshot.

- red: low bike availability;
- green: intermediate inventory;
- blue: high bike availability;
- gray: inactive station.

### 7.1 Define the System Map Bounds

```{python}
state_color = {
    "Low bikes": "red",
    "Balanced": "green",
    "High bikes": "blue",
    "Inactive": "gray",
}
```

```{python}
min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat = (
    stations_gdf.total_bounds
)

lat_pad = max(
    0.01,
    0.05
    * (
        max_lat
        - min_lat
    ),
)

lon_pad = max(
    0.01,
    0.05
    * (
        max_lon
        - min_lon
    ),
)

system_bounds = [
    [
        min_lat
        - lat_pad,
        min_lon
        - lon_pad,
    ],
    [
        max_lat
        + lat_pad,
        max_lon
        + lon_pad,
    ],
]

map_center = [
    stations_gdf[
        "lat"
    ].median(),
    stations_gdf[
        "lon"
    ].median(),
]
```

### 7.2 Interactive Map

```{python}
station_map = folium.Map(
    location=map_center,
    zoom_start=10,
    min_zoom=8,
    max_zoom=18,
    min_lat=system_bounds[0][0],
    max_lat=system_bounds[1][0],
    min_lon=system_bounds[0][1],
    max_lon=system_bounds[1][1],
    max_bounds=True,
    tiles="OpenStreetMap",
)

station_map.fit_bounds(
    system_bounds
)
```

```{python}
cluster = MarkerCluster(
    name="Capital Bikeshare stations"
).add_to(
    station_map
)

for _, row in (
    stations_gdf
    .iterrows()
):

    state = str(
        row[
            "inventory_state"
        ]
    )

    color = state_color.get(
        state,
        "gray",
    )

    popup_html = f"""
    <b>{row['name']}</b><br>
    Short name: {row['short_name']}<br>
    Capacity: {row['capacity']}<br>
    Bikes available: {row['num_bikes_available']}<br>
    Docks available: {row['num_docks_available']}<br>
    Bike fill ratio: {row['bike_fill_ratio']:.1%}<br>
    State: {state}
    """

    folium.CircleMarker(
        location=[
            row["lat"],
            row["lon"],
        ],
        radius=5,
        color=color,
        fill=True,
        fill_opacity=0.75,
        popup=folium.Popup(
            popup_html,
            max_width=300,
        ),
        tooltip=row[
            "name"
        ],
    ).add_to(
        cluster
    )

folium.LayerControl().add_to(
    station_map
)

station_map
```

## Part 8 — Load DC ZIP-Code Polygons

```{python}
zip_path = (
    raw_dir
    / "dc_zip_codes.geojson"
)

zip_gdf = (
    gpd.read_file(
        zip_path
    )
    .to_crs(
        "EPSG:4326"
    )
)
```

```{python}
zip_field_candidates = [
    "ZIP_CODE_TEXT",
    "ZIPCODE",
    "ZIP_CODE",
]

zip_field = next(
    (
        col
        for col
        in zip_field_candidates
        if col
        in zip_gdf.columns
    ),
    None,
)

if zip_field is None:
    raise ValueError(
        "No recognized ZIP-code field was found."
    )
```

```{python}
zip_gdf[
    "ZIP_CODE"
] = (
    zip_gdf[
        zip_field
    ]
    .astype(
        "string"
    )
    .str.replace(
        r"\.0$",
        "",
        regex=True,
    )
    .str.zfill(5)
)
```

### 8.1 Select Geographic ZIP Polygons

```{python}
if "TYPE" in zip_gdf.columns:

    zip_gdf[
        "ZIP_TYPE"
    ] = (
        zip_gdf[
            "TYPE"
        ]
        .astype(
            "string"
        )
        .str.strip()
    )

    standard_zip_mask = (
        zip_gdf[
            "ZIP_TYPE"
        ]
        .str.lower()
        .eq(
            "standard"
        )
        .fillna(
            False
        )
    )

else:

    zip_gdf[
        "ZIP_TYPE"
    ] = pd.NA

    standard_zip_mask = pd.Series(
        False,
        index=zip_gdf.index,
    )
```

```{python}
if standard_zip_mask.any():

    zip_analysis_gdf = (
        zip_gdf.loc[
            standard_zip_mask
        ]
        .copy()
    )

else:

    zip_analysis_gdf = (
        zip_gdf
        .copy()
    )
```

```{python}
zip_analysis_gdf[
    "zip_area_m2"
] = (
    zip_analysis_gdf
    .to_crs(
        "EPSG:3857"
    )
    .geometry
    .area
    .to_numpy()
)
```

```{python}
zip_layer_audit = pd.Series(
    {
        "All ZIP polygons":
            len(
                zip_gdf
            ),

        "Polygons used for regional analysis":
            len(
                zip_analysis_gdf
            ),

        "Unique regional ZIP codes":
            zip_analysis_gdf[
                "ZIP_CODE"
            ].nunique(),
    },
    name="Count",
)

zip_layer_audit.to_frame()
```

## Part 9 — Assign Each Station to a ZIP Code

### 9.1 Spatial Join

```{python}
station_zip_matches = (
    gpd.sjoin(
        stations_gdf,
        zip_analysis_gdf[
            [
                "ZIP_CODE",
                "ZIP_TYPE",
                "zip_area_m2",
                "geometry",
            ]
        ],
        how="left",
        predicate="within",
    )
    .drop(
        columns=[
            "index_right"
        ],
        errors="ignore",
    )
)
```

### 9.2 Resolve Overlapping ZIP Matches

```{python}
zip_match_counts = (
    station_zip_matches
    .groupby(
        "station_id"
    )
    .size()
)

multiple_zip_matches = (
    zip_match_counts
    > 1
).sum()
```

If a station is contained in more than one remaining polygon, the largest geographic polygon is used for the regional assignment.

```{python}
stations_with_zip = (
    station_zip_matches
    .sort_values(
        [
            "station_id",
            "zip_area_m2",
        ],
        ascending=[
            True,
            False,
        ],
        na_position="last",
    )
    .drop_duplicates(
        subset=[
            "station_id"
        ],
        keep="first",
    )
    .copy()
)
```

```{python}
if len(
    stations_with_zip
) != len(
    stations_gdf
):

    raise ValueError(
        "ZIP assignment did not preserve one row per station."
    )
```

```{python}
stations_with_zip[
    "zip_match_count"
] = (
    stations_with_zip[
        "station_id"
    ]
    .map(
        zip_match_counts
    )
)

stations_with_zip[
    "is_dc"
] = (
    stations_with_zip[
        "ZIP_CODE"
    ]
    .notna()
)
```

```{python}
zip_assignment_validation = pd.Series(
    {
        "Stations":
            len(
                stations_with_zip
            ),

        "Stations assigned to DC ZIP":
            stations_with_zip[
                "is_dc"
            ].sum(),

        "Stations outside DC ZIP layer":
            (
                ~stations_with_zip[
                    "is_dc"
                ]
            ).sum(),

        "Stations with multiple raw ZIP matches":
            multiple_zip_matches,
    },
    name="Count",
)

zip_assignment_validation.to_frame()
```

```{python}
class ZipSelectorControl(
    MacroElement
):

    def __init__(
        self,
        map_name,
        zip_layer_name,
        cluster_name,
        marker_map,
        zip_rows,
    ):

        super().__init__()

        self._name = (
            "ZipSelectorControl"
        )

        self.map_name = (
            map_name
        )

        self.zip_layer_name = (
            zip_layer_name
        )

        self.cluster_name = (
            cluster_name
        )

        self.marker_map_json = (
            json.dumps(
                marker_map
            )
        )

        self.zip_rows_json = (
            json.dumps(
                zip_rows
            )
        )

        self._template = Template(
r"""
{% macro header(this, kwargs) %}

<style>

.zip-selector-control {
    background: white;
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow:
        0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    width: 220px;
    font-family:
        Arial,
        sans-serif;
}

.zip-selector-title {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.zip-selector-summary {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #555;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.zip-selector-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 5px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.zip-selector-actions button {
    flex: 1;
    border: 1px solid #bbb;
    background: #f7f7f7;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 5px 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 11px;
}

.zip-selector-actions button:hover {
    background: #ececec;
}

.zip-selector-list {
    max-height: 260px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border-top: 1px solid #ddd;
    padding-top: 5px;
}

.zip-selector-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    padding: 4px 2px;
    font-size: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.zip-selector-row:hover {
    background: #f5f5f5;
}

.zip-selector-row input {
    margin: 0;
}

.zip-selector-count {
    color: #777;
    margin-left: auto;
    font-size: 11px;
}

</style>

{% endmacro %}


{% macro script(this, kwargs) %}

(function() {

    const map =
        {{ this.map_name }};

    const zipLayer =
        {{ this.zip_layer_name }};

    const stationCluster =
        {{ this.cluster_name }};

    const markersByZip =
        {{ this.marker_map_json | safe }};

    const zipRows =
        {{ this.zip_rows_json | safe }};

    const selectedZips =
        new Set();


    /*
     * Start with no stations displayed.
     */

    stationCluster.clearLayers();


    /*
     * Create ZIP selector control.
     */

    const ZipControl =
        L.Control.extend({

            options: {
                position: "topright"
            },

            onAdd: function() {

                const container =
                    L.DomUtil.create(
                        "div",
                        "zip-selector-control"
                    );

                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="zip-selector-title">
                        Select ZIP Codes
                    </div>

                    <div
                        class="zip-selector-summary"
                        id="zip-selection-summary"
                    >
                        0 ZIPs · 0 stations
                    </div>

                    <div class="zip-selector-actions">

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            id="zip-select-all"
                        >
                            All
                        </button>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            id="zip-clear"
                        >
                            Clear
                        </button>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            id="zip-zoom"
                        >
                            Zoom
                        </button>

                    </div>

                    <div
                        class="zip-selector-list"
                        id="zip-selector-list"
                    ></div>
                `;

                L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(
                    container
                );

                L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(
                    container
                );

                return container;
            }

        });


    map.addControl(
        new ZipControl()
    );


    const list =
        document.getElementById(
            "zip-selector-list"
        );


    /*
     * Build ZIP list.
     */

    zipRows.forEach(
        item => {

            const label =
                document.createElement(
                    "label"
                );

            label.className =
                "zip-selector-row";

            const checkbox =
                document.createElement(
                    "input"
                );

            checkbox.type =
                "checkbox";

            checkbox.dataset.zip =
                item.zip;


            const text =
                document.createElement(
                    "span"
                );

            text.textContent =
                item.zip;


            const count =
                document.createElement(
                    "span"
                );

            count.className =
                "zip-selector-count";

            count.textContent =
                `${item.stations} stations`;


            label.appendChild(
                checkbox
            );

            label.appendChild(
                text
            );

            label.appendChild(
                count
            );

            list.appendChild(
                label
            );


            checkbox.addEventListener(
                "change",
                function() {

                    toggleZip(
                        item.zip,
                        checkbox.checked
                    );

                }
            );

        }
    );


    /*
     * Update stations, polygons,
     * checkboxes, and summary.
     */

    function updateMap() {

        stationCluster.clearLayers();

        let stationCount = 0;


        /*
         * Show stations only
         * in selected ZIP codes.
         */

        selectedZips.forEach(
            zipCode => {

                const markerNames =
                    markersByZip[
                        zipCode
                    ] || [];

                markerNames.forEach(
                    markerName => {

                        const marker =
                            window[
                                markerName
                            ];

                        if (marker) {

                            stationCluster.addLayer(
                                marker
                            );

                            stationCount += 1;

                        }

                    }
                );

            }
        );


        /*
         * Highlight selected ZIP polygons.
         */

        zipLayer.eachLayer(
            layer => {

                const zipCode =
                    String(
                        layer
                        .feature
                        .properties
                        .ZIP_CODE
                    );

                if (
                    selectedZips.has(
                        zipCode
                    )
                ) {

                    layer.setStyle({
                        fillColor:
                            "#f5b041",

                        fillOpacity:
                            0.32,

                        color:
                            "#d35400",

                        weight:
                            3
                    });

                    layer.bringToFront();

                }

                else {

                    layer.setStyle({
                        fillColor:
                            "#d9d9d9",

                        fillOpacity:
                            0.06,

                        color:
                            "#666666",

                        weight:
                            1.2
                    });

                }

            }
        );


        /*
         * Synchronize checkboxes.
         */

        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#zip-selector-list input"
        ).forEach(
            checkbox => {

                checkbox.checked =
                    selectedZips.has(
                        checkbox.dataset.zip
                    );

            }
        );


        /*
         * Update summary.
         */

        const summary =
            document.getElementById(
                "zip-selection-summary"
            );

        summary.textContent =
            `${selectedZips.size} ZIPs · `
            +
            `${stationCount} stations`;

    }


    /*
     * Toggle a ZIP.
     */

    function toggleZip(
        zipCode,
        forceState
    ) {

        const shouldSelect =
            forceState !== undefined
            ?
            forceState
            :
            !selectedZips.has(
                zipCode
            );


        if (shouldSelect) {

            selectedZips.add(
                zipCode
            );

        }

        else {

            selectedZips.delete(
                zipCode
            );

        }


        updateMap();

    }


    /*
     * Clicking a polygon also
     * selects or deselects the ZIP.
     */

    zipLayer.eachLayer(
        layer => {

            const zipCode =
                String(
                    layer
                    .feature
                    .properties
                    .ZIP_CODE
                );

            layer.on(
                "click",
                function(event) {

                    L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(
                        event
                    );

                    toggleZip(
                        zipCode
                    );

                }
            );

        }
    );


    /*
     * Select all ZIPs.
     */

    document
        .getElementById(
            "zip-select-all"
        )
        .addEventListener(
            "click",
            function() {

                zipRows.forEach(
                    item => {

                        selectedZips.add(
                            item.zip
                        );

                    }
                );

                updateMap();

            }
        );


    /*
     * Clear all selections.
     */

    document
        .getElementById(
            "zip-clear"
        )
        .addEventListener(
            "click",
            function() {

                selectedZips.clear();

                updateMap();

            }
        );


    /*
     * Zoom to selected ZIPs.
     */

    document
        .getElementById(
            "zip-zoom"
        )
        .addEventListener(
            "click",
            function() {

                const bounds =
                    L.latLngBounds([]);

                zipLayer.eachLayer(
                    layer => {

                        const zipCode =
                            String(
                                layer
                                .feature
                                .properties
                                .ZIP_CODE
                            );

                        if (
                            selectedZips.has(
                                zipCode
                            )
                        ) {

                            bounds.extend(
                                layer.getBounds()
                            );

                        }

                    }
                );


                if (
                    bounds.isValid()
                ) {

                    map.fitBounds(
                        bounds.pad(
                            0.08
                        )
                    );

                }

            }
        );


    updateMap();

})();

{% endmacro %}
"""
        )
```

```{python}

    ZipSelectorControl(
        map_name=

        zip_layer_name=
            zip_layer.get_name(),

        marker_map=
```

# Historical Flow & Dynamic Simulation

## Part 11 — Construct Station-Level Hourly Flows

Historical rides are converted into station-by-hour flows.

For station $i$ and hour $k$,

$$
D_{i,k}
=
\text{observed departures},
$$

$$
A_{i,k}
=
\text{observed arrivals},
$$

and

$$
N_{i,k}
=
A_{i,k}-D_{i,k}.
$$

Negative $N_{i,k}$ indicates net bike loss; positive $N_{i,k}$ indicates net accumulation.

### 11.1 Prepare Historical Trip Events

```{python}
trips = trips_raw.copy()

trips[
    "started_at"
] = pd.to_datetime(
    trips[
        "started_at"
    ],
    errors="coerce",
)

trips[
    "ended_at"
] = pd.to_datetime(
    trips[
        "ended_at"
    ],
    errors="coerce",
)

trips[
    "duration_seconds"
] = (
    trips[
        "ended_at"
    ]
    -
    trips[
        "started_at"
    ]
).dt.total_seconds()
```

```{python}
study_start = pd.Timestamp(
    "2025-01-01 00:00:00"
)

study_end = pd.Timestamp(
    "2025-02-01 00:00:00"
)
```

```{python}
timestamp_audit = pd.Series(
    {
        "Missing parsed start times":
            trips[
                "started_at"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Missing parsed end times":
            trips[
                "ended_at"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Trip starts in January":
            (
                (
                    trips[
                        "started_at"
                    ]
                    >= study_start
                )
                &
                (
                    trips[
                        "started_at"
                    ]
                    < study_end
                )
            ).sum(),

        "Trip ends in January":
            (
                (
                    trips[
                        "ended_at"
                    ]
                    >= study_start
                )
                &
                (
                    trips[
                        "ended_at"
                    ]
                    < study_end
                )
            ).sum(),

        "Trips shorter than 60 seconds":
            (
                trips[
                    "duration_seconds"
                ]
                < 60
            ).sum(),
    },
    name="Count",
)

timestamp_audit.to_frame()
```

Departures and arrivals are treated independently because station activity forms an open station network: a ride may begin or end outside a docked station.

```{python}
departure_events = (
    trips.loc[
        (
            trips[
                "started_at"
            ]
            >= study_start
        )
        &
        (
            trips[
                "started_at"
            ]
            < study_end
        )
        &
        trips[
            "start_station_id"
        ].notna(),
        [
            "ride_id",
            "started_at",
            "start_station_id",
            "start_station_name",
        ],
    ]
    .copy()
)

arrival_events = (
    trips.loc[
        (
            trips[
                "ended_at"
            ]
            >= study_start
        )
        &
        (
            trips[
                "ended_at"
            ]
            < study_end
        )
        &
        trips[
            "end_station_id"
        ].notna(),
        [
            "ride_id",
            "ended_at",
            "end_station_id",
            "end_station_name",
        ],
    ]
    .copy()
)
```

### 11.2 Standardize Station IDs

```{python}
def normalize_short_name(
    series
):
    result = (
        series
        .astype(
            "string"
        )
        .str.strip()
        .str.replace(
            r"\.0+$",
            "",
            regex=True,
        )
    )

    return result.where(
        result.notna()
        &
        result.ne("")
    )
```

```{python}
departure_events[
    "short_name"
] = normalize_short_name(
    departure_events[
        "start_station_id"
    ]
)

arrival_events[
    "short_name"
] = normalize_short_name(
    arrival_events[
        "end_station_id"
    ]
)
```

```{python}
    * event_match_audit[
        "With station ID"
    ]
    /
    event_match_audit[
        "Events in January"
    ]
)

event_match_audit[
    "Reference match rate (%)"
] = (
    100
    * event_match_audit[
        "Matched to reference network"
    ]
    /
    event_match_audit[
        "With station ID"
    ]
)

event_match_audit.round(2)
```

```{python}
unmatched_departures = (
    departure_events.loc[

        ]

unmatched_departures[

] = "Departure"

unmatched_arrivals = (

    )

    .reset_index(

)

unmatched_arrivals[
    "event_type"
] = "Arrival"

unmatched_station_events = (
    pd.concat(
        [

unmatched_station_events.head(
```

### 11.4 Aggregate Hourly Departures and Arrivals

```{python}
matched_departures = (
    departure_events.loc[
        departure_events[
            "matched"
        ]
    ]
    .copy()
)

matched_departures[
    "time"
] = (
    matched_departures[
        "started_at"
    ]
    .dt.floor(
        "h"
    )
)

hourly_departures = (
    matched_departures
    .groupby(
        [
            "time",
            "short_name",
        ]
    )
    .size()
    .reset_index(
        name="departures"
    )
)
```

```{python}
matched_arrivals = (
    arrival_events.loc[
        arrival_events[
            "matched"
        ]
    ]
    .copy()
)

matched_arrivals[
    "time"
] = (
    matched_arrivals[
        "ended_at"
    ]
    .dt.floor(
        "h"
    )
)

hourly_arrivals = (
    matched_arrivals
    .groupby(
        [
            "time",
            "short_name",
        ]
    )
    .size()
    .reset_index(
        name="arrivals"
    )
)
```

### 11.5 Construct the Station-Hour Panel

```{python}
active_short_names = sorted(
    set(
        matched_departures[
            "short_name"
        ]
        .dropna()
    )
    |
    set(
        matched_arrivals[
            "short_name"
        ]
        .dropna()
    )
)

hour_grid = pd.date_range(
    start=study_start,
    end=study_end,
    freq="h",
    inclusive="left",
)
```

```{python}
station_hour_grid = (
    pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
        [
            hour_grid,
            active_short_names,
        ],
        names=[
            "time",
            "short_name",
        ],
    )
    .to_frame(
        index=False
    )
)
```

```{python}
station_hourly_flows = (
    station_hour_grid
    .merge(
        hourly_departures,
        on=[
            "time",
            "short_name",
        ],
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
    .merge(
        hourly_arrivals,
        on=[
            "time",
            "short_name",
        ],
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
)
```

```{python}
station_hourly_flows[
    [
        "departures",
        "arrivals",
    ]
] = (
    station_hourly_flows[
        [
            "departures",
            "arrivals",
        ]
    ]
    .fillna(0)
    .astype(int)
)

station_hourly_flows[
    "net_flow"
] = (
    station_hourly_flows[
        "arrivals"
    ]
    -
    station_hourly_flows[
        "departures"
    ]
)

station_hourly_flows[
    "station_events"
] = (
    station_hourly_flows[
        "arrivals"
    ]
    +
    station_hourly_flows[
        "departures"
    ]
)
```

```{python}
station_hourly_flows = (
    station_hourly_flows
    .merge(
        station_lookup,
        on="short_name",
        how="left",
        validate="many_to_one",
    )
)
```

```{python}
station_hourly_flows[
    "date"
] = (
    station_hourly_flows[
        "time"
    ]
    .dt.normalize()
)

station_hourly_flows[
    "hour"
] = (
    station_hourly_flows[
        "time"
    ]
    .dt.hour
)

station_hourly_flows[
    "day_of_week"
] = (
    station_hourly_flows[
        "time"
    ]
    .dt.day_name()
)

station_hourly_flows[
    "is_weekend"
] = (
    station_hourly_flows[
        "time"
    ]
    .dt.dayofweek
    .ge(5)
)
```

```{python}
station_hourly_flows = (
    station_hourly_flows
    .sort_values(
        [
            "time",
            "short_name",
        ]
    )
    .reset_index(

    )
)

station_hourly_flows[
```

### 11.6 Validate the Flow Table

```{python}
expected_rows = (
    len(
        hour_grid
    )
    *
    len(
        active_short_names
    )
)

flow_validation = pd.Series(
    {
        "Hourly intervals":
            len(
                hour_grid
            ),

        "Stations in historical network":
            len(
                active_short_names
            ),

        "Station-hour rows":
            len(
                station_hourly_flows
            ),

        "Expected station-hour rows":
            expected_rows,

        "Total matched departures":
            station_hourly_flows[
                "departures"
            ].sum(),

        "Total matched arrivals":
            station_hourly_flows[
                "arrivals"
            ].sum(),

        "Monthly net station flow":
            station_hourly_flows[
                "net_flow"
            ].sum(),

        "Missing reference station IDs":
            station_hourly_flows[
                "reference_station_id"
            ].isna().sum(),

        "Missing reference capacity":
            station_hourly_flows[
                "reference_capacity"
            ].isna().sum(),
    },
    name="Value",
)

flow_validation.to_frame()
```

The station network is open: rides may enter or leave the docked-station network, so aggregate net station flow is not required to equal zero.

```{python}
if len(
    station_hourly_flows
) != expected_rows:

    raise ValueError(
        "The station-hour panel is incomplete."
    )

if (
    station_hourly_flows[
        "departures"
    ].sum()
    !=
    matched_departures.shape[0]
):

    raise ValueError(
        "Hourly departure totals do not match "
        "the matched departure events."
    )

if (
    station_hourly_flows[
        "arrivals"
    ].sum()
    !=
    matched_arrivals.shape[0]
):

    raise ValueError(
        "Hourly arrival totals do not match "
        "the matched arrival events."
    )

if (
    station_hourly_flows[
        [
            "reference_station_id",
            "reference_capacity",
            "lat",
            "lon",
        ]
    ]
    .isna()
    .any()
    .any()
):

    raise ValueError(
        "Matched historical stations are missing "
        "reference metadata."
    )
```

## Part 12 — Demand, Imbalance, and Scenario Selection

The first optimization experiment uses Washington, DC stations with a valid geographic ZIP assignment.

### 12.1 Define the DC Analysis Scope

### 12.3 Select a Representative Weekday

The representative day is the weekday whose 24-hour departure and arrival profile is closest to the median weekday profile.

```{python}
median_profile_reference = (
    weekday_hourly_profile[
        [
            "departures",
            "arrivals",
        ]
    ]
    .rename(
        columns={
            "departures":
                "median_departures",

            "arrivals":
                "median_arrivals",
        }
    )
    .reset_index()
)
```

```{python}
weekday_profile_comparison = (
    weekday_system
    .merge(
        median_profile_reference,
        on="hour",
        how="left",
        validate="many_to_one",
    )
)

weekday_profile_comparison[
    "profile_absolute_error"
] = (
    (
        weekday_profile_comparison[
            "departures"
        ]
        -
        weekday_profile_comparison[
            "median_departures"
        ]
    )
    .abs()
    +
    (
        weekday_profile_comparison[
            "arrivals"
        ]
        -
        weekday_profile_comparison[
            "median_arrivals"
        ]
    )
    .abs()
) / 2
```

```{python}
weekday_profile_scores = (
    weekday_profile_comparison
    .groupby(
        "date",
        as_index=False,
    )
    .agg(
        profile_mae=(
            "profile_absolute_error",
            "mean",
        ),

        departures=(
            "departures",
            "sum",
        ),

        arrivals=(
            "arrivals",
            "sum",
        ),

        daily_activity=(
            "activity",
            "sum",
        ),
    )
)
```

```{python}
representative_row = (
    weekday_profile_scores
    .sort_values(
        [
            "profile_mae",
            "date",
        ]
    )
    .iloc[0]
)

scenario_date = (
    representative_row[
        "date"
    ]
)

scenario_date
```

```{python}

    weekday_profile_scores[

    ]
    .median()
)
```


### 12.4 Select the Peak Operating Window

```{python}
representative_day_activity = (
    system_hourly.loc[
        system_hourly[
            "date"
        ]
        == scenario_date
    ]
    .copy()
)

peak_hour = int(
    representative_day_activity.loc[
        representative_day_activity[
            "activity"
        ].idxmax(),
        "hour",
    ]
)

scenario_start_hour = max(
    0,
    peak_hour - 1,
)

scenario_end_hour = min(
    24,
    peak_hour + 2,
)

scenario_hours = list(
    range(
        scenario_start_hour,
        scenario_end_hour,
    )
)
```

### 12.5 Build the Selected Scenario

```{python}

)
```

### 12.8 Scenario Imbalance Map

The map summarizes regional net bike flow during the selected scenario. ZIP-code shading represents aggregate imbalance, while the most imbalanced stations are shown individually.

## Part 13 — Inventory Dynamics, Initial Conditions, and Numerical Simulation

Station inventory follows

$$
S_{i,k+1}
=
S_{i,k}
+
A_{i,k}
-
D_{i,k}
+
U_{i,k}.
$$

A continuous-time representation is

$$
\frac{dS_i}{dt}
=
a_i(t)-d_i(t)+u_i(t).
$$

For a time step $\Delta t$, the unconstrained inventory balance has the Forward Euler form

$$
S_i^{n+1}
=
S_i^n
+
\Delta t
\left[
a_i(t_n)
-
d_i(t_n)
+
u_i(t_n)
\right].
$$

Historical January 2025 station inventories are not observed. The baseline scenario therefore initializes the station network at 50% of reference capacity and tests alternative initial conditions separately.

### 13.1 Define the Simulation Network

Current reference capacity is used as a structural capacity proxy. Current GBFS bike inventory is not used as the historical initial condition.

### 13.2 Initial-Condition Policy

For baseline fill ratio $\rho$,

$$
S_i(0)
\approx
\rho C_i,
\qquad
\rho=0.50.
$$

The allocation preserves the target system-wide fill ratio while keeping station inventories integer-valued.

```{python}
def make_initial_inventory(
    capacity,
    fill_ratio,
):
    capacity = (
        capacity
        .astype(int)
        .copy()
    )

    raw_inventory = (
        fill_ratio
        * capacity
    )

    initial_inventory = (
        np.floor(
            raw_inventory
        )
        .astype(int)
    )

    target_total = int(
        round(
            raw_inventory.sum()
        )
    )

    remainder = (
        target_total
        - initial_inventory.sum()
    )

    if remainder > 0:

        fractional_part = (
            raw_inventory
            - initial_inventory
        )

        add_one = (
            fractional_part
            .sort_values(
                ascending=False
            )
            .head(
                remainder
            )
            .index
        )

        initial_inventory.loc[
            add_one
        ] += 1

    return initial_inventory
```

Observed departure and arrival events are re-aggregated directly from their timestamps so that numerical sensitivity can be tested at different time resolutions.

```{python}
scenario_start_time, scenario_end_time
```

```{python}
def build_simulation_flow_table(
    step_minutes,
):

    frequency = (
        f"{step_minutes}min"
    )

    step_grid = pd.date_range(
        start=
            scenario_start_time,
        end=
            scenario_end_time,
        freq=
            frequency,
        inclusive=
            "left",
    )

    departure_subset = (
        matched_departures.loc[
            (
                matched_departures[
                    "started_at"
                ]
                >= scenario_start_time
            )
            &
            (
                matched_departures[
                    "started_at"
                ]
                < scenario_end_time
            )
            &
            matched_departures[
                "short_name"
            ].isin(
                simulation_short_names
            )
        ]
        .copy()
    )

    arrival_subset = (
        matched_arrivals.loc[
            (
                matched_arrivals[
                    "ended_at"
                ]
                >= scenario_start_time
            )
            &
            (
                matched_arrivals[
                    "ended_at"
                ]
                < scenario_end_time
            )
            &
            matched_arrivals[
                "short_name"
            ].isin(
                simulation_short_names
            )
        ]
        .copy()
    )

    departure_subset[
        "time"
    ] = (
        departure_subset[
            "started_at"
        ]
        .dt.floor(
            frequency
        )
    )

    arrival_subset[
        "time"
    ] = (
        arrival_subset[
            "ended_at"
        ]
        .dt.floor(
            frequency
        )
    )

    departure_counts = (
        departure_subset
        .groupby(
            [
                "time",
                "short_name",
            ]
        )
        .size()
        .reset_index(
            name=
                "departures"
        )
    )

    arrival_counts = (
        arrival_subset
        .groupby(
            [
                "time",
                "short_name",
            ]
        )
        .size()
        .reset_index(
            name=
                "arrivals"
        )
    )

    station_grid = (
        pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
            [
                step_grid,
                simulation_station_table[
                    "short_name"
                ],
            ],
            names=[
                "time",
                "short_name",
            ],
        )
        .to_frame(
            index=False
        )
    )

    flow_table = (
        station_grid
        .merge(
            departure_counts,
            on=[
                "time",
                "short_name",
            ],
            how="left",
            validate=
                "one_to_one",
        )
        .merge(
            arrival_counts,
            on=[
                "time",
                "short_name",
            ],
            how="left",
            validate=
                "one_to_one",
        )
    )

    flow_table[
        [
            "departures",
            "arrivals",
        ]
    ] = (
        flow_table[
            [
                "departures",
                "arrivals",
            ]
        ]
        .fillna(0)
        .astype(int)
    )

    flow_table = (
        flow_table
        .merge(
            simulation_station_table[
                [
                    "short_name",
                    "station_name",
                    "capacity",
                    "lat",
                    "lon",
                    "ZIP_CODE",
                ]
            ],
            on=
                "short_name",
            how=
                "left",
            validate=
                "many_to_one",
        )
    )

    dt_hours = (
        step_minutes
        / 60
    )

    flow_table[
        "arrival_rate"
    ] = (
        flow_table[
            "arrivals"
        ]
        /
        dt_hours
    )

    flow_table[
        "departure_rate"
    ] = (
        flow_table[
            "departures"
        ]
        /
        dt_hours
    )

    return flow_table
```

```{python}
)
```

### 13.4 Capacity-Constrained Inventory Simulation

Within each numerical interval, rebalancing is applied first, followed by departure requests and arrival requests.

For departures,

$$
\widetilde D_{i,k}
=
\min
\left(
D_{i,k},
S_{i,k}^{+}
\right),
$$

where $S_{i,k}^{+}$ is inventory after rebalancing.

Unmet departure demand is

$$
L_{i,k}^{D}
=
D_{i,k}
-
\widetilde D_{i,k}.
$$

Accepted arrivals satisfy

$$
\widetilde A_{i,k}
=
\min
\left(
A_{i,k},
C_i
-
S_{i,k}^{+}
+
\widetilde D_{i,k}
\right),
$$

with blocked arrivals

$$
L_{i,k}^{A}
=
A_{i,k}
-
\widetilde A_{i,k}.
$$

The constrained update becomes

$$
S_{i,k+1}
=
S_{i,k}^{+}
-
\widetilde D_{i,k}
+
\widetilde A_{i,k}.
$$

```{python}
def greedy_threshold_rebalance(
    inventory,
    capacity,
    bike_budget,
    low_threshold=0.25,
    high_threshold=0.75,
    target_fill=0.50,
):

    inventory = (
        inventory
        .copy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    capacity = (
        capacity
        .copy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    fill_ratio = (
        inventory
        /
        capacity
    )

    target_inventory = (
        make_initial_inventory(
            capacity,
            target_fill,
        )
    )

    donor_supply = (
        inventory
        -
        target_inventory
    ).clip(
        lower=0
    )

    receiver_need = (
        target_inventory
        -
        inventory
    ).clip(
        lower=0
    )

    donor_supply = (
        donor_supply.loc[
            (
                fill_ratio
                >= high_threshold
            )
            &
            (
                donor_supply
                > 0
            )
        ]
        .sort_values(
            ascending=False
        )
    )

    receiver_need = (
        receiver_need.loc[
            (
                fill_ratio
                <= low_threshold
            )
            &
            (
                receiver_need
                > 0
            )
        ]
        .sort_values(
            ascending=False
        )
    )

    delta = pd.Series(
        0,
        index=
            inventory.index,
        dtype=int,
    )

    transfers = []

    remaining_budget = int(
        bike_budget
    )

    for receiver in (
        receiver_need.index
    ):

        need = int(
            receiver_need.loc[
                receiver
            ]
        )

        if (
            need <= 0
            or
            remaining_budget <= 0
        ):
            continue

        for donor in (
            donor_supply.index
        ):

            available = int(
                donor_supply.loc[
                    donor
                ]
            )

            if available <= 0:
                continue

            moved = min(
                need,
                available,
                remaining_budget,
            )

            if moved <= 0:
                continue

            delta.loc[
                donor
            ] -= moved

            delta.loc[
                receiver
            ] += moved

            donor_supply.loc[
                donor
            ] -= moved

            need -= moved

            remaining_budget -= moved

            transfers.append(
                {
                    "from_short_name":
                        donor,
                    "to_short_name":
                        receiver,
                    "bikes":
                        moved,
                }
            )

            if (
                need <= 0
                or
                remaining_budget <= 0
            ):
                break

        if remaining_budget <= 0:
            break

    if delta.sum() != 0:

        raise ValueError(
            "Heuristic rebalancing does not conserve bikes."
        )

    return (
        delta,
        transfers,
    )
```

```{python}
def simulate_inventory(
    flow_table,
    step_minutes,
    initial_fill_ratio=0.50,
    policy="none",
    rebalancing_budget=0,
):

    station_table = (
        simulation_station_table
        .set_index(
            "short_name"
        )
    )

    station_ids = (
        station_table.index
        .tolist()
    )

    capacity = (
        station_table[
            "capacity"
        ]
        .astype(int)
    )

    inventory = (
        make_initial_inventory(
            capacity,
            initial_fill_ratio,
        )
    )

    simulation_records = []
    transfer_records = []

    dt_hours = (
        step_minutes
        / 60
    )

    for time, block in (
        flow_table
        .groupby(
            "time",
            sort=True,
        )
    ):

        block = (
            block
            .set_index(
                "short_name"
            )
            .reindex(
                station_ids
            )
        )

        start_inventory = (
            inventory
            .copy()
        )

        rebalance_delta = pd.Series(
            0,
            index=
                station_ids,
            dtype=int,
        )

        if policy == "heuristic":

            (
                rebalance_delta,
                transfers,
            ) = (
                greedy_threshold_rebalance(
                    inventory=
                        inventory,
                    capacity=
                        capacity,
                    bike_budget=
                        rebalancing_budget,
                )
            )

            for transfer in transfers:

                transfer[
                    "time"
                ] = time

                transfer_records.append(
                    transfer
                )

        inventory_after_rebalancing = (
            inventory
            +
            rebalance_delta
        )

        if (
            (
                inventory_after_rebalancing
                < 0
            ).any()
            or
            (
                inventory_after_rebalancing
                > capacity
            ).any()
        ):

            raise ValueError(
                "Rebalancing produced an infeasible inventory."
            )

        requested_departures = (
            block[
                "departures"
            ]
            .fillna(0)
            .astype(int)
        )

        requested_arrivals = (
            block[
                "arrivals"
            ]
            .fillna(0)
            .astype(int)
        )

        arrival_rate = (
            requested_arrivals
            /
            dt_hours
        )

        departure_rate = (
            requested_departures
            /
            dt_hours
        )

        unconstrained_end_inventory = (
            inventory_after_rebalancing
            +
            dt_hours
            * (
                arrival_rate
                -
                departure_rate
            )
        )

        served_departures = pd.Series(
            np.minimum(
                requested_departures,
                inventory_after_rebalancing,
            ),
            index=
                station_ids,
            dtype=int,
        )

        unmet_departures = (
            requested_departures
            -
            served_departures
        )

        inventory_after_departures = (
            inventory_after_rebalancing
            -
            served_departures
        )

        available_docks = (
            capacity
            -
            inventory_after_departures
        )

        accepted_arrivals = pd.Series(
            np.minimum(
                requested_arrivals,
                available_docks,
            ),
            index=
                station_ids,
            dtype=int,
        )

        blocked_arrivals = (
            requested_arrivals
            -
            accepted_arrivals
        )

        end_inventory = (
            inventory_after_departures
            +
            accepted_arrivals
        )

        if (
            (
                end_inventory
                < 0
            ).any()
            or
            (
                end_inventory
                > capacity
            ).any()
        ):

            raise ValueError(
                "Simulation produced inventory outside station capacity."
            )

        step_result = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "time":
                    time,

                "time_end":
                    (
                        time
                        +
                        pd.Timedelta(
                            minutes=
                                step_minutes
                        )
                    ),

                "short_name":
                    station_ids,

                "station_name":
                    station_table.loc[
                        station_ids,
                        "station_name",
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "capacity":
                    capacity.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "start_inventory":
                    start_inventory.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "rebalance_delta":
                    rebalance_delta.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "inventory_after_rebalancing":
                    inventory_after_rebalancing.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "requested_departures":
                    requested_departures.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "served_departures":
                    served_departures.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "unmet_departures":
                    unmet_departures.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "requested_arrivals":
                    requested_arrivals.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "accepted_arrivals":
                    accepted_arrivals.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "blocked_arrivals":
                    blocked_arrivals.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "unconstrained_end_inventory":
                    unconstrained_end_inventory.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),

                "end_inventory":
                    end_inventory.loc[
                        station_ids
                    ].to_numpy(),
            }
        )

        step_result[
            "end_fill_ratio"
        ] = (
            step_result[
                "end_inventory"
            ]
            /
            step_result[
                "capacity"
            ]
        )

        simulation_records.append(
            step_result
        )

        inventory = (
            end_inventory
            .copy()
        )

    simulation_result = (
        pd.concat(
            simulation_records,
            ignore_index=True,
        )
    )

    transfers_result = pd.DataFrame(
        transfer_records,
        columns=[
            "time",
            "from_short_name",
            "to_short_name",
            "bikes",
        ],
    )

    return (
        simulation_result,
        transfers_result,
    )
```

### 13.6 Reactive Rebalancing Benchmark

The heuristic is intentionally simple: stations at or below 25% fill can receive bikes from stations at or above 75% fill, with a 50% target.

The hourly relocation budget is set to 1% of total modeled station capacity. This is a scenario parameter rather than an observed Capital Bikeshare operating limit.

```{python}
total_simulation_capacity = (
    simulation_station_table[
        "capacity"
    ]
    .sum()
)

heuristic_budget_per_hour = max(
    1,
    int(
        round(
            0.01
            * total_simulation_capacity
        )
    ),
)

heuristic_budget_per_hour
```

```{python}

    simulate_inventory(
        flow_table=
            simulation_flows_60,
        step_minutes=
            60,
        initial_fill_ratio=
            baseline_fill_ratio,
        policy=
            "heuristic",
        rebalancing_budget=
            heuristic_budget_per_hour,
    )
)
```

### 13.7 Compare the Two Policies

```{python}
def summarize_simulation(
    simulation,
    transfers,
    policy_name,
):

    requested_departures = (
        simulation[
            "requested_departures"
        ]
        .sum()
    )

    requested_arrivals = (
        simulation[
            "requested_arrivals"
        ]
        .sum()
    )

    served_departures = (
        simulation[
            "served_departures"
        ]
        .sum()
    )

    accepted_arrivals = (
        simulation[
            "accepted_arrivals"
        ]
        .sum()
    )

    unmet_departures = (
        simulation[
            "unmet_departures"
        ]
        .sum()
    )

    blocked_arrivals = (
        simulation[
            "blocked_arrivals"
        ]
        .sum()
    )

    requested_events = (
        requested_departures
        +
        requested_arrivals
    )

    served_events = (
        served_departures
        +
        accepted_arrivals
    )

    bikes_rebalanced = (
        transfers[
            "bikes"
        ].sum()
        if len(
            transfers
        ) > 0
        else 0
    )

    empty_station_intervals = (
        simulation[
            "end_inventory"
        ]
        .eq(0)
        .sum()
    )

    full_station_intervals = (
        simulation[
            "end_inventory"
        ]
        .eq(
            simulation[
                "capacity"
            ]
        )
        .sum()
    )

    stations_ever_empty = (
        simulation.loc[
            simulation[
                "end_inventory"
            ]
            == 0,
            "short_name",
        ]
        .nunique()
    )

    stations_ever_full = (
        simulation.loc[
            simulation[
                "end_inventory"
            ]
            ==
            simulation[
                "capacity"
            ],
            "short_name",
        ]
        .nunique()
    )

    return {
        "Policy":
            policy_name,

        "Requested departures":
            requested_departures,

        "Served departures":
            served_departures,

        "Unmet departures":
            unmet_departures,

        "Requested arrivals":
            requested_arrivals,

        "Accepted arrivals":
            accepted_arrivals,

        "Blocked arrivals":
            blocked_arrivals,

        "Total service failures":
            (
                unmet_departures
                +
                blocked_arrivals
            ),

        "Service success rate":
            (
                served_events
                /
                requested_events
                if requested_events > 0
                else np.nan
            ),

        "Stations ever empty":
            stations_ever_empty,

        "Stations ever full":
            stations_ever_full,

        "Empty station-intervals":
            empty_station_intervals,

        "Full station-intervals":
            full_station_intervals,

        "Bikes rebalanced":
            bikes_rebalanced,
    }
```

```{python}

policy_kpis
```

### 13.11 Time-Step Sensitivity

The operational model is also tested with finer time intervals.

This is a numerical robustness check rather than a formal order-of-convergence estimate because the capacity constraints introduce clipping and the forcing is constructed from discrete observed events.

```{python}
step_sizes = [
    60,
    30,
    15,
    5,
]

step_simulations = {}
step_sensitivity_rows = []

for step_minutes in (
    step_sizes
):

    flow_table = (
        build_simulation_flow_table(
            step_minutes
        )
    )

    simulation_result, _ = (
        simulate_inventory(
            flow_table=
                flow_table,
            step_minutes=
                step_minutes,
            initial_fill_ratio=
                baseline_fill_ratio,
            policy=
                "none",
        )
    )

    step_simulations[
        step_minutes
    ] = simulation_result

    summary = (
        summarize_simulation(
            simulation_result,
            pd.DataFrame(
                columns=[
                    "bikes"
                ]
            ),
            f"{step_minutes} min",
        )
    )

    step_sensitivity_rows.append(
        {
            "Step minutes":
                step_minutes,

            "Unmet departures":
                summary[
                    "Unmet departures"
                ],

            "Blocked arrivals":
                summary[
                    "Blocked arrivals"
                ],

            "Total service failures":
                summary[
                    "Total service failures"
                ],
        }
    )
```

The simulated service failures are hypothetical failures under the assumed initial inventory and station capacities. They are not estimates of actual historical unmet demand.

The optimized policy in Part 14 will use the same inventory and service accounting framework so that its performance can be compared directly with the no-rebalancing and heuristic benchmarks.

# Linear Optimization

## Part 14 — Linear Bike Rebalancing Model: Formulation and Solution

Let

$$
x_{ij,k}
=
\text{bikes rebalanced from station } i
\text{ to station } j
\text{ during interval } k.
$$

The LP also includes

$$
y_{i,k}^{D}
=
\text{served departures},
$$

$$
y_{i,k}^{A}
=
\text{accepted arrivals},
$$

and service-failure variables

$$
u_{i,k}^{D}
=
D_{i,k}-y_{i,k}^{D},
$$

$$
u_{i,k}^{A}
=
A_{i,k}-y_{i,k}^{A}.
$$

The objective is

$$
\min
\left[
\sum_k
\sum_{(i,j)\in E}
c_{ij}x_{ij,k}
+
\lambda
\sum_k
\sum_i
\left(
u_{i,k}^{D}
+
u_{i,k}^{A}
\right)
\right].
$$

The model is a continuous linear program. Integer bike transfers are not imposed in this stage.

### 14.1 Inventory and Service Constraints

Let $S_{i,k}$ be inventory at the beginning of interval $k$.

After rebalancing,

$$
R_{i,k}
=
S_{i,k}
+
\sum_j x_{ji,k}
-
\sum_j x_{ij,k}.
$$

The station balance is

$$
S_{i,k+1}
=
R_{i,k}
-
y_{i,k}^{D}
+
y_{i,k}^{A}.
$$

The LP enforces

$$
0
\leq
R_{i,k}
\leq
C_i,
$$

$$
0
\leq
y_{i,k}^{D}
\leq
D_{i,k},
$$

$$
y_{i,k}^{D}
\leq
R_{i,k},
$$

and

$$
0
\leq
y_{i,k}^{A}
\leq
A_{i,k},
$$

$$
y_{i,k}^{A}
\leq
C_i
-
R_{i,k}
+
y_{i,k}^{D}.
$$

Only bikes present at the beginning of an interval can be sent out for rebalancing:

$$
\sum_j x_{ij,k}
\leq
S_{i,k}.
$$

The hourly rebalancing resource limit is

$$
\sum_{(i,j)\in E}
x_{ij,k}
\leq
B_k.
$$

### 14.2 Construct the Candidate Rebalancing Network

Straight-line geographic distance is used as the relocation-cost proxy. Each station is connected to a local set of nearby stations to keep the optimization network operationally local and computationally manageable.

```{python}
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix
```

```{python}
optimization_station_table = (
    simulation_station_table
    .sort_values(
        "short_name"
    )
    .reset_index(
        drop=True
    )
    .copy()
)

station_ids = (
    optimization_station_table[
        "short_name"
    ]
    .tolist()
)

station_count = len(
    optimization_station_table
)

station_index = {
    station_id: i
    for i, station_id
    in enumerate(
        station_ids
    )
}
```

```{python}
def haversine_distance_matrix(
    latitudes,
    longitudes,
):

    earth_radius_km = 6371.0088

    lat = np.radians(
        np.asarray(
            latitudes,
            dtype=float,
        )
    )

    lon = np.radians(
        np.asarray(
            longitudes,
            dtype=float,
        )
    )

    dlat = (
        lat[:, None]
        -
        lat[None, :]
    )

    dlon = (
        lon[:, None]
        -
        lon[None, :]
    )

    a = (
        np.sin(
            dlat / 2
        ) ** 2
        +
        np.cos(
            lat[:, None]
        )
        *
        np.cos(
            lat[None, :]
        )
        *
        np.sin(
            dlon / 2
        ) ** 2
    )

    return (
        2
        *
        earth_radius_km
        *
        np.arcsin(
            np.sqrt(
                np.clip(
                    a,
                    0,
                    1,
                )
            )
        )
    )
```

```{python}
distance_matrix = (
    haversine_distance_matrix(
        optimization_station_table[
            "lat"
        ],
        optimization_station_table[
            "lon"
        ],
    )
)

np.fill_diagonal(
    distance_matrix,
    np.inf,
)
```

Each station is connected to its 12 nearest stations. The graph is made symmetric so a selected station pair can be used in either direction.

```{python}
neighbor_count = min(
    12,
    station_count - 1,
)

candidate_edge_pairs = set()

for i in range(
    station_count
):

    nearest_stations = (
        np.argsort(
            distance_matrix[
                i
            ]
        )[
            :neighbor_count
        ]
    )

    for j in (
        nearest_stations
    ):

        if i == j:
            continue

        candidate_edge_pairs.add(
            (
                i,
                int(j),
            )
        )

        candidate_edge_pairs.add(
            (
                int(j),
                i,
            )
        )
```

```{python}
candidate_edges = []

for i, j in sorted(
    candidate_edge_pairs
):

    candidate_edges.append(
        {
            "origin_index":
                i,

            "destination_index":
                j,

            "origin_short_name":
                station_ids[i],

            "destination_short_name":
                station_ids[j],

            "distance_km":
                float(
                    distance_matrix[
                        i,
                        j,
                    ]
                ),
        }
    )

candidate_edges = pd.DataFrame(
    candidate_edges
)

edge_count = len(
    candidate_edges
)

candidate_edges.head()
```

### 14.4 Define the LP Variables

```{python}
n_x = (
    time_count
    * edge_count
)

n_s = (
    (
        time_count + 1
    )
    * station_count
)

n_departure_service = (
    time_count
    * station_count
)

n_arrival_service = (
    time_count
    * station_count
)

n_unmet_departures = (
    time_count
    * station_count
)

n_blocked_arrivals = (
    time_count
    * station_count
)
```

```{python}
offset_x = 0

offset_s = (
    offset_x
    + n_x
)

offset_departure_service = (
    offset_s
    + n_s
)

offset_arrival_service = (
    offset_departure_service
    + n_departure_service
)

offset_unmet_departures = (
    offset_arrival_service
    + n_arrival_service
)

offset_blocked_arrivals = (
    offset_unmet_departures
    + n_unmet_departures
)

number_of_variables = (
    offset_blocked_arrivals
    + n_blocked_arrivals
)
```

```{python}
def idx_x(
    k,
    e,
):
    return (
        offset_x
        +
        k
        * edge_count
        +
        e
    )


def idx_s(
    k,
    i,
):
    return (
        offset_s
        +
        k
        * station_count
        +
        i
    )


def idx_departure_service(
    k,
    i,
):
    return (
        offset_departure_service
        +
        k
        * station_count
        +
        i
    )


def idx_arrival_service(
    k,
    i,
):
    return (
        offset_arrival_service
        +
        k
        * station_count
        +
        i
    )


def idx_unmet_departure(
    k,
    i,
):
    return (
        offset_unmet_departures
        +
        k
        * station_count
        +
        i
    )


def idx_blocked_arrival(
    k,
    i,
):
    return (
        offset_blocked_arrivals
        +
        k
        * station_count
        +
        i
    )
```

```{python}
objective_coefficients[

    offset_blocked_arrivals
] = (
    service_failure_penalty
)

objective_coefficients[
    offset_blocked_arrivals:

)
```

```{python}
eq_rows = []
eq_cols = []
eq_data = []
b_eq = []

eq_constraint_metadata = []

ub_rows = []
ub_cols = []
ub_data = []
b_ub = []

ub_constraint_metadata = []
```

```{python}
def add_eq_constraint(
    coefficients,
    rhs,
    category,
    time=None,
    station=None,
):

    row_number = len(
        b_eq
    )

    for variable_index, value in (
        coefficients
    ):

        if value == 0:
            continue

        eq_rows.append(
            row_number
        )

        eq_cols.append(
            variable_index
        )

        eq_data.append(
            value
        )

    b_eq.append(
        float(
            rhs
        )
    )

    eq_constraint_metadata.append(
        {
            "row":
                row_number,

            "category":
                category,

            "time":
                time,

            "short_name":
                station,

            "rhs":
                float(
                    rhs
                ),
        }
    )
```

```{python}
def add_ub_constraint(
    coefficients,
    rhs,
    category,
    time=None,
    station=None,
):

    row_number = len(
        b_ub
    )

    for variable_index, value in (
        coefficients
    ):

        if value == 0:
            continue

        ub_rows.append(
            row_number
        )

        ub_cols.append(
            variable_index
        )

        ub_data.append(
            value
        )

    b_ub.append(
        float(
            rhs
        )
    )

    ub_constraint_metadata.append(
        {
            "row":
                row_number,

            "category":
                category,

            "time":
                time,

            "short_name":
                station,

            "rhs":
                float(
                    rhs
                ),
        }
    )
```

### 14.7 Solve the Linear Program

```{python}
lp_result = linprog(
    c=
        objective_coefficients,
    A_ub=
        A_ub,
    b_ub=
        b_ub,
    A_eq=
        A_eq,
    b_eq=
        b_eq,
    bounds=
        bounds,
    method=
        "highs",
)
```

```{python}
solver_summary = pd.Series(
    {
        "Success":
            lp_result.success,

        "Status":
            lp_result.status,

        "Message":
            lp_result.message,

        "Objective value":
            (
                lp_result.fun
                if lp_result.success
                else np.nan
            ),

        "Iterations":
            getattr(
                lp_result,
                "nit",
                np.nan,
            ),
    },
    name="Value",
)

solver_summary.to_frame()
```

```{python}
if not lp_result.success:

    raise RuntimeError(
        "The rebalancing LP did not solve successfully: "
        f"{lp_result.message}"
```
